summary: LATAM Airlines Group S.A., a Chilean foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 8, 2026, containing its operating statistics for August 2026. The exhibit reports a 7.0% increase in consolidated capacity (ASK) year-over-year, a 4.7% rise in traffic (RPK), a load factor of 83.5%, 7.9 million passengers transported, and cargo metrics including 87 thousand tons carried. This is routine operational disclosure, not a special situation. There are no M&A terms, board actions, advisors, or structural mechanics. The filing is informational and does not signal any corporate transaction or event. Watch for future earnings releases or strategic updates, but no risk-arb angle applies.
